author: reactive-end
summary: New Tier 0 rule no-swallowed-errors. It flags an empty or comment-only catch in TS/JS/PHP/Kotlin/Dart, `.catch(() => {})`, `except: pass` or `...`, and an unguarded Rust `Err(..) => {}` or `()` arm. Per the user's choice it applies to newly added lines only, through NEW_CODE_ONLY_RULES and retain_new_code_findings in anvil check and both hook gates; when added lines are unknown every finding is kept. The benchmark has 43 cases: no-swallowed-errors caught 6, 0 false positives, and 1 known gap (a handler emptied by deleting its only statement).
evidence: 6 rule unit tests incl. new-code filter; slop_bench 43 cases ok; 465 workspace tests; clippy -D warnings, fmt, anvil check PASS; calibration over local repos (Anvil 1, Fliiper 89, Orbit Labs 37, ElMio 53, Catclysm 8 handlers)
